rubricContent.textProperty: The briefing strictly maintains a calm Chief of Staff tone. The overnight summary is exactly six plain-text sentences without bolding inside the summary body. There are zero emojis, zero hyperbole, and zero sensationalized phrases.
The response filters out routine chatter and low-priority messages, prioritizing leadership directives and actionable escalations.
All active Hot List priorities are accounted for. If a topic has no unread messages in the trailing 3 days, it outputs the exact fallback format: 'On topic [Topic] no updates yet.'
AI market intelligence reflects technical breakthroughs (architectures, reasoning, systems scaling) suitable for a Head of AI/ML, strictly within the trailing 72-hour window.
The briefing text strictly omits calendar agenda sections and meeting schedules per executive privacy and focus requirements.
